analysis.summary: Flow makes Fortnite improvement videos (practice routines, editing, settings, game sense) and, lately, videos about playing older seasons through Project Retrac. The thumbnails never show a face: a skin mid-build, heavily saturated purple and blue, under one short gold headline.
analysis.niche: Fortnite improvement guides and Project Retrac (older seasons)

styleTraits.title: Two templates, one per era
styleTraits.detail: The coaching videos use three stacked words in thick yellow and white letters with a dark outline ('GET BETTER FAST', 'PROS DO THIS'). Since about September 2026, almost every upload uses one gold headline banner across the top ('RETRAC IS PEAKING', 'ITS PERFECT', 'IS IT WORTH IT?') over a bright build-fight screenshot.

styleTraits.title: Before and after in one frame
styleTraits.detail: The best tutorials split the image in two: a grey, desaturated 'before' side with a red X and a red outline around the skin, and a colourful 'after' side with a green check and a green outline. 'GET BETTER FAST', 'EDIT BETTER FAST' and the '120 FPS' to '360 FPS' settings video all use it.

styleTraits.title: No face, the skin from behind
styleTraits.detail: Flow does not use a camera or a close-up character face. The player is a small skin seen from behind, jumping or building, so the text and the colours do the work.

styleTraits.title: Icons as shorthand
styleTraits.detail: Recent thumbnails add two icons on the sides: a gold crown-shaped rank emblem, a sunglasses duck sticker in a green square, or a blue Fortnite 'F' tile. They act as quick labels for 'ranked', 'Retrac' or 'Fortnite news' without extra words.

styleTraits.title: Text gives the feeling, the title gives the topic
styleTraits.detail: The thumbnail rarely repeats the title. 'I Played Fortnite Chapter 2 Season 4 in 2026...' becomes 'THIS IS SO FUN'; 'No Matter What Happens, FORTNITE Will NEVER die...' becomes 'FORTNITES ALIVE!' next to a player-count screenshot.

standouts.why: About 184,000 views, 14.2 times the channel's median. The frame is a clean before and after: grey half with a red X and a red-outlined skin, colour half with a green check and a green-outlined skin, and 'GET BETTER FAST' in big gold letters. The transformation can be read in a second, which probably suits a promise as broad as improving fast.

About 80,000 views, 6.2 times the median. The thumbnail does not explain the topic at all: just 'THIS IS SO FUN', a gold rank emblem and the duck sticker over a bright build fight. The nostalgia in the title (an old season played in 2026) may have done most of the work, with the thumbnail adding the emotion. Later uploads in the same banner-and-icons layout landed lower, mostly between 0.6 and 3.2 times the median.

About 79,000 views, 6.1 times the median. 'PROS HIDE THIS ROUTINE' in lime green, white and yellow, with a red arrow pointing at a skin in mid-air. The title says 'best practice routine'; the thumbnail turns it into a secret, which is a second reason to click rather than a copy of the title.

lessons: If your video promises a change, show both states in one image: a grey 'before' half and a colourful 'after' half, marked with an X and a check. Flow's two biggest tutorials both use this.
Make the thumbnail text add something the title does not say. 'PROS HIDE THIS ROUTINE' adds a secret to a title about a routine.

When a topic works, give it a fixed look so regular viewers spot the series, but check the numbers: after the first Retrac video hit 6.2 times the median, later ones in the same layout mostly landed between 0.6 and 3.2 times.
Long 'course' videos can travel if the thumbnail names them as a guide: the two-hour 'ULTIMATE FORTNITE GUIDE' reached about 27,000 views, twice the median.
Tournament diaries with a posed skin and 'SO CLOSE.' sat near 4,000 to 5,000 views, about a third of the median. Broad improvement promises pulled far more than personal match recaps on this channel.
analysis.experiment: On your next tutorial, make two thumbnails: your usual one, and a split version with a desaturated 'before' half (red X) and a colourful 'after' half (green check) with three words at most. Run them in YouTube's Test & Compare and keep the winner as a template if it wins.

faq.q: What does Flow make videos about?
faq.a: Fortnite improvement: practice routines, editing speed, keyboard and graphics settings, VOD reviews and long game-sense guides. Since about September 2026 many uploads are about Project Retrac, a way to play older Fortnite seasons, plus opinion videos on the state of the game and a few tournament diaries.

faq.a: Bright, very saturated Fortnite build fights in purple, blue and pink, with no face. Recent uploads put one short gold headline across the top and two icons on the sides (a rank emblem, a duck sticker, a Fortnite 'F' tile). Older tutorials use stacked yellow and white words and before-and-after splits with a red X and a green check.

Fortnite, mostly competitive build mode: ranked, Arena, Reload and tournament play. Recent videos also cover older Fortnite seasons played again through Project Retrac, such as Chapter 2 Season 2 and Chapter 2 Season 4.
